description_sq:
Pjese e nje objekti relativisht te ri, i mireadministruar ne nje zone qe ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
- Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 98.7m2 te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes + ambienti i gatimit/ngrenies, dhoma e gjumit, 2 tualete, nje ballkon me pamje te lire dhe korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve.
Apartamenti momentalisht eshte pershtatur si nje 1+1 spacioz por mund te kthehet lehtesisht serisht ne nje 2+1.
- Apartamenti ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar si ne foto.
Orientimi eshte jug-lindje.
- Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe mund te shitet me kredi.
Se bashku me apartamentin shitet dhe nje post parkimi me 2 depo me cmim ekstra.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in AnnA Complex
description_en: Part of a relatively new, well-managed facility in an area that offers all the facilities for a comfortable life. - The apartment has a total area of ​​98.7m2 organized in the living room + kitchen/dining room, bedroom, 2 toilets, a balcony with a free view and the corridor that distributes the premises. The apartment is currently adapted as a spacious 1+1 but can easily be converted into a 2+1. - The apartment is offered fully furnished as in the photo. The orientation is south-east. - Has regular mortgage documentation and can be sold on credit. Along with the apartment, a parking post with 2 storage rooms is sold at an extra price. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
